title: Oven Roasted Argentinian Mustard Stew
description: A fiery, mustardy stew that melds tangy kimchi and creamy onions, roasted to a gooey perfection in a classic kazan cauldron.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and place a cast-iron kazan cauldron on the rack.
Drizzle the olive oil into the empty cauldron and swirl until it coats the base.
Add the sliced onions and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they soften.
Stir in the chopped kimchi, whole grain mustard, and smoked paprika, coating everything evenly.
Pour in the beef broth and red wine, then drop in the bay leaf, and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Cover the cauldron with its lid, transfer it to the preheated oven, and roast for 30 minutes, turning once halfway through.
After 30 minutes, remove the lid, stir the stew, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Return the cauldron to the oven, uncovered, and continue roasting for another 15 minutes to deepen the flavors.
Once done, let the stew rest for 5 minutes before removing the bay leaf.
Ladle the stew into bowls, serve hot, and enjoy the gooey mustard-infused flavors.
